references.text: Jesus challenges the disciples' lack of understanding and faith, which recalls the disciples' doubt in Mark 8:14
Jesus feeds 5000 men, plus women and children, with five loaves and two fish, demonstrating his ability to feed many in a desolate place, similar to the situation in Mark 8:14
Jesus feeds 5000 men with five loaves and two fish, paralleling how the disciples doubt Jesus' ability to feed people in Mark 8:14
